set.body:
Epic: bd-01M1Z987V50254M59P9MNGP9FH
Delivery phase: 4 of 6; child 8 of 12.
Design: docs/design/interaction.md; full snapshot retained in the epic note.
Status: planned work; no implementation or passing evidence is asserted.

Scope
Implement Canvas rendering of interaction state, shared picking/events, tooltips, gestures, linked views, and accessible DOM companion. Complete the baseline coverage matrix across SVG and Canvas and verify every referenced feature category.

Acceptance criteria
1. Matching normalized interaction traces on SVG and Canvas yield the same logical events and selected keys, including batched marks, clipping, transforms, facets, and composition.
2. Canvas has keyboard/focus/inspector access and does not require retaining full rows or wrapping every mark in a DOM node.
3. Both backends pass the two-linked-scatters-plus-histogram example, with pointer/keyboard/touch selection, linked legend, region selection, and viewport controls.
4. Every baseline row in the proposal passes: inspection, emphasis, actions, selection, plot parts, navigation, composition, and embedding. A point-only demo is insufficient.
5. Existing static conformance and compatibility gates pass; an external consumer runs against the exact tested artifact. Publish capability gaps separately from passing checks.

Exclusions
Analytical extensions and large-workload capacity claims cannot substitute for missing baseline features.

Required evidence
Feature-by-feature receipts, browser traces/screenshots, independent picking expectations, exact source/artifact identifiers, accessible interaction checks, and external-consumer results.
Retain tested source SHA, fixture inputs, expected outputs, and actual gate results. Pending or unavailable checks remain explicitly pending.

Prerequisites
bd-01M1Z9B35H6R8703MBVT4EFCFD

Coordination
Reserve only actual files when implementation starts. Parent containment is not a prerequisite on the epic; do not create a child-to-epic dependency cycle.
set.title: [Intaglio][Interaction 08] Deliver Canvas interaction parity and certify the ggiraph feature baseline
